title: Isolation readiness scoring and engagement lane for enterprise air-gapped requests
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Problem: Enterprise customers increasingly request private/VPC or air-gapped deployments but our current intake is ad-hoc and focuses on checklist items rather than an actionable isolation readiness score. This makes prioritization, routing to engineering lanes, and creating realistic onboarding timelines inconsistent. Objective: Create a deterministic scoring model and engagement lane that translates a customer's networking posture, upgrade tolerance, and airgap constraints into a prioritized intake decision and recommended onboarding runway. The deliverable will be: (1) a scoring rubric (quantitative) for network/isolation readiness, (2) an engagement lane decision tree with SLA expectations and required preflight artifacts, (3) a lightweight self-serve network probe template we can share with customers to accelerate triage, and (4) playbook content for PM/SE/CS to standardize comms and escalation. Success metrics: reduce average initial triage time from 7 days to 48 hours for high-value requests; increase predictability of onboarding timelines within ±2 weeks; reduce engineering surprise work (undisclosed proxied dependencies) by 40%.
